task: For each paper (title, abstract, MeSH headings), record which research systems the reported work used. Judge from what the paper did, not from what it cites or proposes. Return a JSON list with one object per paper.

output_item.model_system: one of: human_samples, animal, cell_only, other
output_item.systems_present: list, any subset of: human_samples, animal, cell

systems_present.human_samples: The work analyzed material or data taken from human patients or people: tumor tissue, biopsies, blood, surgical specimens, mutation testing of patient samples, or patient cohorts. Human cell lines do not count here.
systems_present.animal: The work used living animals: mice, rats, xenografts or transplanted tumors in animals, transgenic or knockout animals, zebrafish, flies, worms, or other whole organisms. Cells taken from an animal species and grown in a dish do not count here.
systems_present.cell: The work used cell lines or cells grown in culture (including organoids and transfected cells), human or animal.

model_system.rule: Pick the first that applies, in this order.
model_system.human_samples: Human samples present, and no animal and no cell work.
model_system.animal: Animal work present, with or without cells or human samples.
model_system.cell_only: Cell work present and no animal work (human samples may also be present).
model_system.other: None of the above, for example purely computational, structural, biochemical, or cell-free work.

definitions.human_genetics: 1 if the paper reports or relies on inherited human genetic evidence: germline mutations, inherited predisposition or susceptibility, polymorphisms or SNPs, genome-wide association, familial or pedigree studies. Somatic tumor mutations alone are 0.
